about: Modwerk's Digitakt II base for OS 1.17, built by npm run machine:base -- digitakt-ii from core-dt2 1.1's source (elekloader#221 at 0df8409, sdk/imports/core-dt2-source-0df8409.json) with the reviewed toolchain (m68k-elf GCC 16.2.0, binutils 2.47), identified by its SHA-256 in sdk/machines/digitakt-ii/base-binding.json (f41b89cd). The site builds every Digitakt II set on it. Stock-free: each site names its stock bytes by length and SHA-256, and the build fills them from the owner's OS.
